description:
Environmental Services for:

  • National Environmental Protection Act (NEPA) consultation, services and habitat management.
  • Environmental compliance, surveys, assessment, consultant services, inspections, trainings, advisory and lab services.

See attached PWSs for further details.

The Government intends to post a RFQ to establish two, separate hybrid (FFP & T&M) environmental service IDIQs.

Request for Information Questions:

  • Would you be willing to enter into an IDIQ contract for more than 5 years? If so, how many?
  • Which services can you provide under these PWSs?
  • Do you have experience within the past 5 years of performing these services within Europe on military installations?

Please provide any comments or questions to the contact information listed.
